description: Retrieve the full content of one record by its id — a company profile with fundamentals and recent announcements; one announcement (id alert:<id>, the id from recent_alerts) with THE FILING'S OWN TEXT, the company's filed XBRL figures when it is a results statement, its measured price reaction and the link to the original document on BSE/NSE (long filings come in parts: alert:<id>:2, …); one page of a filing; or one IPO issue. Use this to read a filing — do not try to open the source link. A MarketPing alert link (marketping.in/alerts/… or api.marketping.in/alerts/<id>/attachment) is accepted as the id. When the text carries a WARNING about misread figures, quote figures only from the filed figures. Factual data only — MarketPing publishes no buy/sell recommendations, no price targets and no IPO grey-market premium.

id.description: An id returned by search, alert:<id> from recent_alerts, or a MarketPing alert link

name: fetch
title: Fetch a MarketPing record
